recognize_zh: 中倍免疫染色下，竇內成群的大型棕色陽性組織球細胞質中，清楚可見多顆藍色未染的淋巴球被包在裡面，染色把 emperipolesis 凸顯出來，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病（標記名稱未標示，推測為 S100）。
features: Clusters of large strongly positive histiocytes within sinuses
Numerous unstained (blue) intact lymphocytes enclosed within the positive cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
Some positive cells show dark nuclear as well as cytoplasmic staining
Antibody not specified; pattern compatible with S100
describe_en: Medium-power immunohistochemical stain shows clusters of large positive histiocytes within lymph node sinuses. Many of these cells contain multiple unstained intact lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, highlighting emperipolesis against the brown cytoplasmic background, while the surrounding small lymphocytes are negative. The antibody is not specified; nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity in these histiocytes is compatible with S100. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are S100 positive but CD1a/langerin positive, smaller with grooved nuclei and do not show engulfed intact lymphocytes.
In hemophagocytosis the ingested cells (often red cells and nucleated cells) are degraded within phagolysosomes and the macrophages are S100 negative.
Melanoma cells are S100 positive but show cytologic atypia, SOX10/melan-A positivity and lack emperipolesis.
